{{Quote|As I recall, this port offers some of the most delightfully ''wicked'' heel-cooling spots in the galaxy!|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="marvel50" />}}
'''Terminus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Terminus system/Legends|Terminus system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Terminus sat on the juncture of two of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most important [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]], the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] making it a highly trafficked port despite its remote location on the edges of the Outer Rim's [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. Its proximity to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] meant that strange and unfamiliar [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were a common sight in Terminus' skies.

==Description==
{{Quote|This is one of the ''centers'' for cross-galactic shipping... we can ''lose'' ourselves easily among all this ''traffic.''|Han Solo|<ref name="marvel50" />}}
Located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Kallea sector/Legends|Kallea sector]], at the junction of two of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]]&mdash;the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]&mdash;Terminus sat on the very fringes of the Outer Rim's [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. The planet's unique location made it a bustling [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]], its skies filled with diverse [[Starship/Legends|ships]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by unknown [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Terminus_ground.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A spaceport on Terminus]]
By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Terminus had fallen under the sphere of influence of the [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]].<ref name="hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Terminus became a hunting ground for a group of [[Red Nebula exiles|exiles]] from the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]], who kidnapped a number of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to facilitate a heist of the Nebula's [[Great Life Jewels]]. The exile leader [[Klysk]] took captured passing travelers [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] as they passed through Terminus, among others.<ref name="marvel50" />

Terminus was later portrayed in the popular opera ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'', which depicted [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea's]] establishment of the Hydian Way several millennia before.<ref name="TEA" />
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the remaining [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] survivors of their defeat at the hands of [[Alliance of Free Planets]] forces at the [[Second Battle of Endor]] traveled to Terminus, using it as a waypoint for their retreat up the Hydian Way and the Corellian Trade Spine.<ref name="nagai">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> The Alliance forces followed and [[Battle of Terminus|clashed]] with the Nagai at Terminus, a battle in which the Nagai raiders prevailed.<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
Terminus' main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] featured a number of well-regarded [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and leisure establishments, especially down the side streets where tourists were less likely to look.<ref name="marvel50" />

==Behind the scenes==
Terminus first appeared in ''[[Star Wars (1977) 50|Star Wars 50: The Crimson Forever]]'', written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1981]]. In its comic appearance, the world was illustrated by [[Al Williamson]].<ref name="marvel50" /> Terminus shares a name with a planet that was mentioned in [[George Lucas]]' [[The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller|third story draft]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars:'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but was ultimately removed from the final film.<ref name="making">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>
